📋 Overview
The Verdis Blockchain API provides REST and JSON-RPC interfaces for interacting with the Verdis network — a carbon-negative L1 blockchain with native DPoS consensus, AMM DEX, carbon credits, and smart contracts.
Base URLs
  • REST API: https://verdischain.com/api
  • JSON-RPC: https://rpc.verdischain.com (or https://verdischain.com/rpc)
  • Chain ID: 909
  • Native Token: VRS (18 decimals)
  • Consensus: DPoS (Delegated Proof of Stake)
  • Cryptography: secp256k1 + SHA-256/Keccak256
Quick Start
cURL — Get network info
curl https://verdischain.com/api/network/info
cURL — Create a wallet
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/wallet/create
cURL — Send a transaction
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/transaction/send \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"from":"0x...","privateKey":"0x...","to":"0x...","amount":100}'
JavaScript — JSON-RPC
const response = await fetch('https://rpc.verdischain.com', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0', id:1, method:'eth_chainId', params:[]}) }); const data = await response.json(); // → {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":"0x38d"}
🔐 Authentication
Most endpoints are public. Admin-only endpoints require an API key.
Admin API Key
  • Header: x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
  • Query: ?apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY
  • Retrieve key: GET /api/security/admin-key (localhost only)
  • Admin endpoints: POST /api/blockchain/produce, POST /api/bridge/redeem, GET /api/security/events
⏱ Rate Limiting
All endpoints are rate-limited to protect the network.
TierLimitWindowApplied To
Standard30 reqper minuteAll endpoints
Strict5 reqper minuteTransactions, swaps, contract deploy, bridge, faucet, staking
Response Headers
  • X-RateLimit-Remaining — requests left in current window
  • X-RateLimit-Reset — seconds until window resets
  • 429 Too Many Requests — returns {"error":"Rate limit exceeded","retryAfter":N}
⚡ GET /api/network/tps
Real-time network throughput statistics including TPS, peak TPS, and block timing.
GET /api/network/tps ▶
Returns live transactions-per-second metrics, block timing, and network uptime. Also available via WebSocket at /ws.
Response
{ "tps": 2.4, "blockTime": 5000, "avgBlockTime": 5002, "totalTxs": 12480, "txsLastMinute": 12, "peakTPS": 8.7, "uptime": 86400, "lastBlockTime": 1693526400000 }
WebSocket
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://rpc.verdischain.com/ws'); ws.onmessage = (e) => { const data = JSON.parse(e.data); if (data.type === 'stats') console.log('TPS:', data.stats.tps); if (data.type === 'block') console.log('New block! TPS:', data.tps); };
id="jsonrpc">
🔗 JSON-RPC Methods (25)
Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC at https://rpc.verdischain.com. POST with {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"...","params":[],"id":1}.
POSTeth_chainId▶
Returns the chain ID as hex.
Request
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_chainId","params":[],"id":1}
Response
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":"0x38d"}
POSTeth_blockNumber▶
Returns current block number as hex.
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[],"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":"0x4a3c"}
POSTeth_getBalance▶
Returns VRS balance of an address.
ParamTypeReqDescription
addressstringYes0x-prefixed address
blockTagstringNo"latest" or hex number
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getBalance","params":["0xa1e8...","latest"],"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":"0x3b9aca00"}
POSTeth_sendRawTransaction▶
Submits a signed raw transaction.
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_sendRawTransaction","params":["0x..."],"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":"0xabc123..."}
POSTeth_getTransactionByHash▶
Returns transaction details by hash.
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getTransactionByHash","params":["0xabc..."],"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"hash":"0x...","from":"0x...","to":"0x...","value":"0x64"}}

🔑 API Keys (External Platform Integration)
Generate API keys with secret keys for exchanges, trackers, wallets, and dApps to integrate with Verdis. HMAC-signed requests supported.
How It Works
  • 1. Create key: POST to /api/keys/create with your platform name, owner, and scopes
  • 2. Receive credentials: Get apiKey + secretKey (secret shown only once!)
  • 3. Authenticate: Pass x-api-key: vrs_... header on protected endpoints
  • 4. HMAC signing (optional): Sign requests with secret key for higher security
Permission Scopes
  • read — Read blockchain data, blocks, transactions, balances, pools (included in all keys)
  • trade — Execute DEX swaps, add/remove liquidity
  • write — Send transactions, deploy contracts, mint tokens/NFTs
  • admin — Full access including block production, bridge redemption (requires admin key to assign)
POST/api/keys/create▶
Generate a new API key + secret key. Returns credentials only once. Strict rate limited.
ParamTypeReqDescription
namestringYesPlatform/app name (e.g. "CoinGecko Tracker")
ownerstringYesOwner address or email
scopesstring[]YesPermission scopes: ["read","trade","write"]
rateLimitnumberNoRequests/min (default: 60)
expiresInDaysnumberNoKey expiry (null = never)
metadata.websitestringNoPlatform website
metadata.descriptionstringNoPlatform description
metadata.webhookUrlstringNoWebhook for event notifications
cURL — Create a read-only key for CoinGecko
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/keys/create \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "CoinGecko Tracker", "owner": "api@coingecko.com", "scopes": ["read"], "rateLimit": 120, "metadata": { "website": "https://coingecko.com", "description": "Price tracking integration" } }'
Response (200)
{ "success": true, "message": "API key created. Store your secret key securely - it will not be shown again.", "keyId": "vk_a1b2c3d4e5f6", "apiKey": "vrs_3f8a9b2c1d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8", "secretKey": "vss_7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8", "name": "CoinGecko Tracker", "scopes": ["read"], "rateLimit": 120, "createdAt": 1692400000000, "expiresAt": null }
GET/api/keys▶
List all API keys with usage stats. Admin Auth Required
cURL
curl https://verdischain.com/api/keys -H "x-api-key: ADMIN_KEY"
Response (200)
{ "keys": [{ "keyId": "vk_a1b2...", "apiKey": "vrs_3f8a...", "name": "CoinGecko Tracker", "owner": "api@coingecko.com", "scopes": ["read"], "rateLimit": 120, "createdAt": 1692400000000, "lastUsed": 1692405000000, "requestCount": 1547, "active": true }], "stats": { "totalKeys": 1, "activeKeys": 1, "totalRequests": 1547, "byScope": { "read": 1, "trade": 0, "write": 0, "admin": 0 } } }
GET/api/keys/:keyId▶
Get usage stats for a specific key. Admin Auth Required
POST/api/keys/:keyId/revoke▶
Revoke an API key permanently. Admin Auth Required
cURL
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/keys/vk_a1b2.../revoke \ -H "x-api-key: ADMIN_KEY"
{"success": true, "message": "Key vk_a1b2... revoked"}
POST/api/keys/:keyId/rotate▶
Rotate an API key (generate new key + secret). Admin Auth Required
Response (200)
{"success": true, "apiKey": "vrs_new...", "secretKey": "vss_new..."}
POST/api/keys/verify▶
Verify an API key (for testing). Supports both simple and HMAC verification.
cURL — Simple verification
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/keys/verify \ -d '{"apiKey": "vrs_3f8a..."}'
{"valid": true, "keyId": "vk_a1b2...", "name": "CoinGecko Tracker", "scopes": ["read"]}
cURL — HMAC verification (more secure)
curl -X POST https://verdischain.com/api/keys/verify \ -d '{ "apiKey": "vrs_3f8a...", "signature": "hmac_sha256_hex...", "timestamp": "1692400000000", "body": "{}" }'
GET/api/keys/stats▶
Get API key system overview stats. Admin Auth Required
{"totalKeys": 5, "activeKeys": 4, "revokedKeys": 1, "totalRequests": 25000, "byScope": {"read": 4, "trade": 2, "write": 1, "admin": 0}}
Integration Example (JavaScript)
Create key and make authenticated request
// 1. Create an API key const createRes = await fetch('https://verdischain.com/api/keys/create', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'My Exchange', owner: 'admin@myexchange.com', scopes: ['read', 'trade'] }) }); const { apiKey, secretKey } = await createRes.json(); // 2. Make authenticated API calls const res = await fetch('https://verdischain.com/api/dex/pools', { headers: { 'x-api-key': apiKey } }); const pools = await res.json(); // 3. HMAC-signed request (higher security) const timestamp = Date.now().toString(); const body = JSON.stringify({trader: '0x...', tokenIn: 'VRS', tokenOut: 'CARBON', amountIn: 100}); const payload = `${apiKey}.${timestamp}.${body}`; const signature = await hmacSha256(secretKey, payload); // use crypto.subtle or similar const swapRes = await fetch('https://verdischain.com/api/dex/swap', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': apiKey, 'x-signature': signature, 'x-timestamp': timestamp }, body });
